title: M4RM Gray-code table build (ILP + SIMD)
description:
## Current

`crates/gf2-core/src/alg/m4rm.rs::build_gray_table` builds a 2^k row table via scalar XOR sequence. Profiled in `m4rm_profile.rs` as a measurable fraction of M4RM total time.

## Fix

PPC walk:

- V2 ILP: replace single accumulator with 8 independent table accumulators so the dependent XOR chain breaks.
- V3 SIMD: batch the 8 accumulators across YMM lanes; reuse `LogicalFns::xor_fn` where possible.
- V6 prefetch: prefetch the next column block's rows while building the current Gray-table.

## Per-kernel execution protocol

Same as B1. Baseline already pinned by I1 (`m4rm_profile`).

## Depends on

I1, I2, I3, I4.

## Success criteria

- [hard] M4RM end-to-end correctness unchanged (existing `m4rm.rs` tests pass).
- [hard] ASM shows 8 independent accumulators and (V3) `vpxor` mnemonics.
- [hard] No regression in M4RM total time on any size class measured by `m4rm_profile`.
- [aspirational] ≥1.5× geomean on the table-build sub-bench.
